entities.name: Grzegorz Skrzecz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Grzegorz Skrzecz was a Polish boxer, world championship medalist, actor, and the twin brother of Paweł Skrzecz. He competed in the men's heavyweight event at the 1980 Summer Olympics.
